prompt:
Use your image generation tool to create exactly one image, then save it as ./magnifier.png in the current working directory. Do not write any code or other files.

SUBJECT: A magnifying glass resting on a long printed paper receipt that curls at one end (the receipt shows only blank ruled lines, no text).

STYLE (identical for every figure in this set):
- A US patent drawing: a single technical-pen line illustration of ONE object, as it would appear on a patent sheet.
- Ink: a single colour, dark forest green #1f3b2b, uniform fine line weight (about 2px at 1600px), clean vector-like strokes, no wobble.
- Shading only with sparse parallel hatching lines where a surface turns away; no fills, no grey tones, no gradients, no colour washes.
- Background: pure flat white #ffffff, edge to edge. No paper texture, no border, no frame, no shadow, no vignette.
- The object is drawn in a three-quarter axonometric view, centred, occupying about 70% of the frame, with generous empty white margin on every side.
- No text, no letters, no numbers, no reference numerals, no leader lines, no labels, no "FIG." caption, no logos, no brand marks anywhere in the image.
- No people, no hands, no photographic realism, no 3D rendering, no cartoon style, no emoji style, no glow.
- Output: one square PNG, 1600x1600.

The attached image is the approved first figure of this set: match its line weight, ink colour, hatching density, view angle and margins exactly. Draw only the new subject.
